svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step three separate metal lines, each a thick silver film between two thin purple ones, stand on a flat pale oxide. After it a thick pale oxide fills the gaps between the lines and buries them; its top is higher over the lines than over the gaps, with sloping sides.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step three separate metal lines, each a thick silver film between two thin purple ones, stand on a flat pale oxide. svg.text: A silicon dioxide is deposited over the
metal lines, filling the gaps between them.
After: the inter-metal oxide over the lines
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
